description: Deletes one registrant from a webinar, which is what a deletion request from a participant needs. Take it when someone asks to be removed: "Please delete Mrs Weber, she asked for it." It needs the session, the webinar, the registrant id from your list and a clear yes from you. Look at the list first and name the person by name and address, so the wrong entry does not go. The entry is gone from the site and cannot be brought back, the person no longer appears in your numbers, and emails already sent are not recalled. Clearing a whole list is on purpose not possible here. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: delete registrant, remove participant, deletion request, GDPR, one person out

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that this one person may be deleted.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_delete_registrant
